title: Trip Protection Premium Rate Schedule
content:
Trip Protection premiums are priced by plan. Each plan sets a premium rate, stated as a percentage of the insured trip cost, and a minimum premium below which no policy on that plan is priced. The rates below apply to the six Trip Protection plans Roamhaven sells to guests on behalf of Harbor Mutual Travel Insurance Company.

## Rates by plan

| Plan | Premium rate (percent of insured trip cost) | Minimum premium (USD) | Rounding of premiums and benefits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | 4.20 | 15.00 | nearest cent, half up |
| Trip Protection Essential | 5.30 | 19.00 | nearest cent, half up |
| Trip Protection Standard | 6.40 | 24.00 | nearest cent, half up |
| Trip Protection Plus | 7.50 | 29.00 | nearest cent, half up |
| Trip Protection Premier | 8.90 | 39.00 | nearest cent, half up |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | 11.80 | 59.00 | nearest cent, half up |

## Reading the schedule

- **Premium rate.** The percentage in the second column is the share of the insured trip cost charged as premium on that plan.
- **Minimum premium.** The figure in the third column is the lowest premium a policy on that plan carries.
- **Rounding.** Every plan rounds both its premiums and its benefits to the nearest cent, with a half cent rounded up.
- The rate rises with the plan: Trip Cancellation Only carries the lowest rate and minimum, and Trip Protection Premier CFAR the highest, at 11.80 percent with a 59.00 USD minimum.

## Points of reference

**Is the rate the same on every Trip Protection plan?** No. Each plan has its own rate and its own minimum, as listed above; a policy is priced at the rate and minimum of the plan it is bought on.

**Does any plan round differently?** No. All six plans round premiums and benefits to the nearest cent, half up; for example, a hypothetical amount of 61.728 USD rounds to 61.73 USD and a hypothetical amount of 40.004 USD rounds to 40.00 USD.
